build_artifact_path_after_finished: build an async function that retrieves the absolute file path of a Playwright artifact after it finishes downloading
create_artifact_save_as: create an async function that saves a Playwright artifact stream to a specified local file path
test_artifact_failure: test the Artifact.failure method to check if a download or capture operation failed and return the error reason
refactor_artifact_read_info_buffer: refactor the Artifact.read_info_buffer method to read artifact data as a bytes buffer from a stream
review_artifact_delete_cancel: review the Artifact.delete and Artifact.cancel methods for cleaning up or aborting unfinished artifact operations
